## About
Noels Express Auto Service is a repair shop at 1522 W Yuma St in Phoenix. We work on all European model vehicles, and Mercedes Benz is our specialty.
Every job starts with an inspection so we get the diagnosis right. Then we get to work so you're not off the road any longer than you need to be. We take the time to do things right instead of rushing through.
Whether it's an oil change, a repair after a breakdown, or a look at a Mercedes you're thinking of buying, give us a call. Drivers here rate us 4.1 from 46 Google reviews.

## Services
- Vehicle repairs: Minor and major repairs after a breakdown or mishap, with a proper diagnosis first so your car runs smoothly again.
- Preventative maintenance: Oil changes, transmission fluid changes, spark plug changes and other routine services. Check your owner's manual and call us when it's time.
- Pre-purchase inspection: Thinking about buying a Mercedes Benz? We inspect the major components under the hood and tell you what we find before you spend your money.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Mercedes Benz?
A: No. We service all European model vehicles. Mercedes Benz is our specialty.

Q: How much will my repair cost?
A: We can only give you a price after we look at your vehicle and find the trouble. Call us to request a free estimate.

Q: Can you check a used Mercedes before I buy it?
A: Yes. Our pre-purchase inspection covers the major components under the hood, and we walk you through what we found.
